object.content: I recently wrote about how I needed to redo the control panel on my Automatic Garden Waterer (http://tinkeringetc.blogspot.com/2012/06/automatic-garden-waterer-part-1.html), so I've been experimenting with using a PIC to control a 16x2 character LCD for the project. I spent last night trying to get my PIC to communicate with the LCD. I believe there was an issue with the way the timing on the chip was set up, but I was unable to display anything on the LCD. Today I pulled out my +Arduino to see what I could get working and in a couple minutes I had made more progress using the Arduino than I had made all night with the PIC. Although I had my Arduino for a few years, I had never used it for anything other than flashing a LED when I first got it. I can definitely see why they are such a popular choice for tinkerers now. With the Arduino, I hopefully can get the panel operational in only a couple nights.
